notes.title: Update 1.07 is UP!
notes.content:
All right! Finally!

The 1.07 update is up! Just in time for the launch of the Express Killer.
Here are 3 of main things we did to our 4 year old game:

[b]Controller support[/b]
You can now use a controller! Weird, right? After all, this is a "point'n'click" game, what happens when we ad controller support? I tell you what, nothing happens. It's just controller support! :)

[b]New engine[/b]
The Express Killer is built on GMS 2.0 but Murder in the Hotel Lisbon is still in the old GMS 1.4 So we decided it would be great to push into the new one, this way we manage to keep up the support with newer chipsets and the game continues to run smoothly.

[b]More bugs crushed[/b]
It sound weird but in the middle of all this we found more bugs! Amazing, right? Not really. We hate it. Specially me. I thought they were all squashed, but moving engines and adding controller support means new bugs. So, more play testing and more QA to get everything tight and nice. Oh well...

Anyway, have fun with the new version. It should feel like a slicker faster version of the original, perfect for speed runs... ;)

notes.title: Incoming UPDATE 1.07 - new stuff!
notes.content:
Hey there fellow detectives!
We know most of you already finished the game and are eager to play the sequel, but this is quite an important update.

So, we grabbed all the work we were doing with the sequel and pushed it back into the original, not only because we care but also to keep everything up to parity with the features we are bringing into the sequel. This means new things for our 4 year old adventure.

[b]Controller support[/b]
You can now use a controller! Weird, right? After all, this is a "point'n'click" game, what happens when we had controller support? I tell you what, nothing happens. It's just controller support :)

[b]New engine[/b]
The Express Killer is built on GMS 2.0 but Murder in the Hotel Lisbon is still in the old GMS 1.4 So we decided it would be great to push into the new one, this way we manage to keep up the support with newer chipsets and the game continues to run smoothly.

[b]More bugs crushed[/b]
It sound weird but in the middle of all this we found more bugs! Amazing, right? Not really. We hate it. Specially me. I thought they were all squashed, but moving engines and adding controller support means new bugs. So, more play testing and more QA to get everything tight and nice. Oh well..

Update 1.07 should be launched around the 10th of July.
Have fun with the Steam sales!

notes.title: Update to v1.04
notes.content:
[h1]Patch v1.04 available now[/h1]

Hey there fellow detectives!
Long time no see! How are your crime solving skills going!?
Argh... who are we kidding... Look, it has been a long time and this patch is 2 years too late, we know, ok!? No more excuses, here are the patch notes:

[list]
[*] [b]English revision.[/b] Somebody took the time to sit down and review it. Mistakes were corrected, bad jokes were reviewed and some other oddities cleaned. STILL. There might be a few mistakes hidden somewhere. Please let us know and we will fix it asap. We also promise to hire a professional team to translate the next game we release.
[*] [b]Steam Cloud.[/b] We now support it. Well, it worked on our end so it should work on yours, right?
[*] [b]Screenshots.[/b] They work! How amazing is that? It was such a silly thing that we are ashamed to even talk about it.
[*] [b]Bugs squashed.[/b] Lot's of them. We read all of the complaints, put the game on a lot of people hands, and tested it all again. Let's hope that final interview thing and the Stand Up Clown thing doesn't pop up again.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6106034/596ddf427f14ecc80f6cba8834110985f0314aec.jpg[/img]

Finally we need to let you know that we will be on top of things so, if you see any other issues, please let us know.

Thanks for the support and to everyone who helped us out.
And if you haven't yet left us a review, please consider taking some time to write a few words, Robot Clown loves reviews! :funnyclownbot::funnyclownbot::funnyclownbot:

notes.title: Win / Mac / Linux - update 1.03
notes.content:
Hi there Steam friends!
Based on all the AWESOME fan feedback, we just updated the game to version 1.03! Uhuu! And what does that mean? It means we had to stop enjoying our vacations in Azores and get back to work ːcoolmonkeyːːcoolmonkeyːːcoolmonkeyː

Anyway, here are the AWESOME changes:
- We corrected all the typos and gramatical errors people found AND told us about. We can't actually correct what we don't know, right?
- Anti-Social achievement is now more firmly secured! What does this mean? Well, let's say we are now double checking to make sure you get it instead of just relying solely on gnomes and fairies.
- We double checked on current difficult achievements like the Cheapskate and Nerd Monkey to ensure they are actually working... they are!
- Some bugs were cleaned, others were sent away.

We are still checking why we can't use the screenshot feature. Our screenshot feature programmer is still on his deserved vacations so we will have to wait and see what is going on.

For now that's it!
Discuss what i just wrote or just advertise some weird stuff so you can get banned. Cheers!
